paragraphs.text: It is a sunny day. The sky is blue. My family is at the orchard.
paragraphs.translation: 今天阳光明媚，天空很蓝。我们一家人来到了苹果园。

paragraphs.text: There are many apple trees. The trees are tall and green. Red apples are on the trees.
paragraphs.translation: 这里有许多苹果树，树又高又绿。红红的苹果挂在树上。

paragraphs.text: My sister has a small basket. The basket is yellow and round. She can pick apples with me.
paragraphs.translation: 妹妹有一个小篮子，篮子又黄又圆。她可以和我一起摘苹果。

paragraphs.text: A little dog runs to us. It is white and brown. It has a red ball. The dog can run fast.
paragraphs.translation: 一只小狗朝我们跑过来。它身上有白毛和棕毛。它有一个红色的球。这只小狗跑得很快。

paragraphs.text: My mother picks ten red apples. My father picks five more apples. We put them in the basket.
paragraphs.translation: 妈妈摘了十个红苹果，爸爸又摘了五个。我们把苹果放进篮子里。

paragraphs.text: I eat one big apple. It is sweet and juicy. I love the apple orchard. We are all happy.
paragraphs.translation: 我吃了一个大苹果，它又甜又多汁。我喜欢这片苹果园，我们都很开心。
